vulnerability_type: Denial of Service via Liquidity Addition Failure

preconditions.description: Attacker must hold sufficient BGLG tokens to trigger the swapback threshold when transferring to the pair address
Contract must have accumulated fees in its balance exceeding the _SWAPBACK_THRESHOLD (1/10000 of totalSupply)
Contract BNB balance must be insufficient relative to token amount for liquidity addition, causing addLiquidityETH to revert

exploit_hint: 1. Accumulate sufficient BGLG tokens in the contract through transfers to pair address (triggers fee collection). 2. Ensure contract has imbalanced BNB-to-token ratio by having tokens swapped but not enough BNB for proportional liquidity. 3. Attempt a transfer to the pair address - this will trigger _sellAndDistributeAccumulatedTKNFee() which calls addLiquidityETH. 4. The addLiquidityETH will revert due to BNB/token disparity, causing the entire transfer transaction to revert. 5. This creates a DoS condition where all transfers to the pair address fail, effectively blocking trading functionality.
